rows: Built inBuilt in properties are set by the Nova Angular component itself or by its parent. These properties are generally not needed to be set or edited.
'tablist' null if nested tab list or within Navigation.
Sets tab list to vertical orientation when true.
Built inBuilt in properties are set by the Nova Angular component itself or by its parent. These properties are generally not needed to be set or edited.

Marks item as selected when true. Can be used with navigational tabs as an alternative to Angular Router's routerLinkActive. When active is true, child buttons will automatically receive aria-current="page". Use [active] when you want to handle the active state of the tab item. Use (activeChange) when you want the library to handle the active state of the tab item, but get notified of changes. Use [(active)] when you want the active state to reflect changes by both you and the library.
Marks the tab as a disclosure item when true. This item cannot be active and should expand and collapse when pressed.

Sets expanded state of disclosure tab item. Use [expanded] when you want to handle the expanded state of the tab item. Use (expandedChange) when you want the library to handle the expanded state of the tab item, but get notified of changes. Use [(expanded)] when you want the expanded state to reflect changes by both you and the library.
Sets role of tab item. If no custom role is set, role may be set by a parent component (nav, tabs, etc.).
Marks the tab as a section title when true. This item titles a subset of tabs and is not interactive.

Marks item as selected when true. Can be used with navigational tabs as an alternative to Angular Router's routerLinkActive. When active is true, child buttons will automatically receive aria-current="page". Use [active] when you want to handle the active state of the tab item. Use (activeChange) when you want the library to handle the active state of the tab item, but get notified of changes. Use [(active)] when you want the active state to reflect changes by both you and the library.
Emits expanded state when the child button is clicked.

Sets expanded state of disclosure tab item. Use [expanded] when you want to handle the expanded state of the tab item. Use (expandedChange) when you want the library to handle the expanded state of the tab item, but get notified of changes. Use [(expanded)] when you want the expanded state to reflect changes by both you and the library.
Built inBuilt in properties are set by the Nova Angular component itself or by its parent. These properties are generally not needed to be set or edited.
Aria attribute relaying whether button is selected. aria-current and aria-selected cannot be used together.
Aria attribute pointing to id of descriptive element. If the button has a badge, the aria-describedby will be set to the badge's id by default.
Sets aria disabled state for accessibility purposes. When true, indicates that the button is disabled and not interactive.
Aria attribute relaying whether button is expanded.
false true when button is used within combobox and no custom value is given.
Sets button to combobox toggle button when true.
Aria attribute relaying whether button is selected. aria-current and aria-selected cannot be used together.
Sets button to destructive variant when true.
Sets role of button. If no custom role is given, role may be set by a parent component (nav, tabs, etc.).
Sets button to subtle variant when true.
null -1 when button is used within combobox and no custom value is given.
